ns2:course.label: Production Practicum II
ns2:course.description: Practical experience in the production of dance concerts mounted in the Krannert Center for the Performing Arts. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. (1 hour credit per concert up to 2 hours per term).
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. (1 hour credit per concert up to 2 hours per term).
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Dance or Dance major(s).
